reader.requirement: At --std 85 a relative file description entry takes the Sequential I-O RECORD clause in all three formats with the same syntax rules (VII.3.8.3 SR1-SR4) and general rules (VII.3.8.4), including the Format 2 bounds that give a WRITE outside them status 44.

edition-consulted.switches: RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize: Format 3 range does not bound WRITEs at 85
rows by Since and the 1985 citation (CitationAt); SR4 names working-storage or linkage only below 2002

reader.edition-search: the clause row in FileDescriptionFormats.Rows is FileDescriptionFormat.All with no edition; BindRecordClause is organization-independent
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only as the sequential RECORD clause itself differs (Format 3 range unbounded at 85, BYTES refused, SR4's section list); the relative module adds nothing of its own
reader.witnesses-cover: part: Format 1 and Format 2 with DEPENDING ON on relative files; not exercised: Format 3, a WRITE outside the Format 2 bounds (44), and the SR1-SR4 refusals on a relative FD

reader.notes: One binder (BindRecordClause) and one rule table (RecordClauseRules) serve every organization, so the relative FD gets exactly the sequential clause. Formats 1, 2 and 3, the 44 boundary and SR1-SR4 were each probed on relative files.

refuter.evidence: Attacked the sequential RECORD clause rules the reader did not carry onto a relative FD: GR10c (no DEPENDING ON, size from the ODO count), GR9, GR11 and GR12. Probe r4_rel.cob at --std 85 (runs/r4_rel-001), relative random: FD RECORD IS VARYING FROM 2 TO 8 with no DEPENDING ON over C PIC 9 + T OCCURS 1 TO 7 DEPENDING ON C: WRITE C=1 and C=7 -> 00, 00; read through a second FD with DEPENDING ON L: R1 L=02 [1A], READ INTO L=08 W=[7BCDEFGH    ] (GR11, GR12 a), READ INTO of the 2-position record L=02 W=[1A          ]; an INVALID KEY READ (23) leaves L=55 (GR9); WRITE with L=5 -> 00 and L unchanged; WRITE L=1 -> 44 (INVALID KEY not taken), REWRITE L=9 -> 44. The relative clause behaves as the sequential one. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.3.2.4 GR5  (3.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5'; 'OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR9  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR9'; 'OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR12  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR12'.
